page.overview:
Who is Baako's husband?

A male individual was the husband of Baako, the brother of Resistance spy Vi Moradi. The couple lived together on Pantora. During a mission on the planet Batuu while Vi thought—albeit incorrectly—that she would die from a poison dart, the spy thought of Baako and his husband, noting to herself that she had yet to meet the latter.

The husband of Baako was mentioned in the 2019 novel Galaxy's Edge: Black Spire, written by Delilah S. Dawson.
